jobs.title: Advisor Practice Management Consultant
jobs.description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. We believe that belonging leads to better outcomes and a stronger community of associates united by our mission. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long-Term Thinking, and Community.

“I can influence my income.”

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.
- Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options

- Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love

- Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

Our Advisor Practice Management team delivers industry-leading learning programs, consulting, and coaching to top advisory teams and partner firms. We strive to be the business partner of choice by helping advisors grow, scale, and strengthen their practices. Leveraging Capital Group's distribution reach and relationships, we bring the proven skills, behaviors, and strategies that drive growth for elite advisory teams.

Guided by our proprietary Pathways to Growth research, we provide tailored learning experiences that help advisors develop and implement critical business-building capabilities at every stage of their careers. Our approach emphasizes practical application, measurable outcomes, and ongoing accountability. Through these engagements, we deepen advisor relationships, create business impact, and strengthen opportunities for partnership with Capital Group.

Advisor Practice Management Consultants (APMCs) engage advisors through keynote presentations, national and regional conferences, interactive workshops, and customized consulting engagements with leading advisory teams. We maintain a strong industry presence through in-person, virtual, and digital experiences that extend Capital Group's practice management expertise to advisors nationwide. Our consulting services are highly sought after for their ability to drive meaningful business growth, leadership, and team transformation.

The APMC role requires leadership, collaboration, adaptability, and creativity. Consultants integrate and customize practice management curriculum across a variety of engagements while partnering with internal stakeholders to develop learning experiences aligned with advisor needs. Credibility is critical, as APMCs advise and coach top financial professionals on topics including client acquisition, leadership, team effectiveness, goals-based investing, retirement planning, AI strategy, and practice growth. Success in this role requires exceptional public speaking, facilitation, consulting, and coaching skills. Approximately 75% of the role is dedicated to workshops and consulting engagements, with roughly one-third conducted in person.

APMCs operate within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment, partnering closely with Strategic Relationship Managers and sales teams across distribution channels to design and deliver customized practice management programs that drive advisor success.

"I can succeed as an Advisor Practice Management Consultant at Capital Group."
- Deliver guided learning through coaching and consulting experiences that help financial advisors and teams adopt new behaviors, strengthen business practices, and grow and scale their businesses.
- Lead a variety of engagements, including keynote presentations, workshops, and consulting sessions for top financial advisors, advisor teams, centers of influence (COIs), and home office leadership teams.
- Partner closely with sales professionals across distribution, including Strategic Relationship Managers, Strategic Sales Managers, Wealth Management Consultants, and Retirement Plan Counselors.
- Represent Capital Group as a thought leader, moderator, and facilitator across a wide range of events, including broker-dealer national and regional conferences, Capital Group Advisor Forum programs, webinars, podcasts, and other advisor engagement initiatives.
- Contribute to national and regional sales meetings by delivering practice management insights and expertise.
- Develop and enhance practice management curriculum, consulting tools, learning resources, workshop content, and sales force insights.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”
- Undergraduate or master's degree required.
- Minimum of 15 years of experience in the financial services industry.
- Experience as a financial advisor, investment management sales professional (wholesaler, retirement plan consultant, national accounts leader), or equivalent role.
- Outstanding communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
- Demonstrated experience coaching and consulting on practice management topics.
- Collaborative team player who embraces diverse perspectives and is innovative, highly organized, energetic, and results-oriented.
- Strong curriculum design and content development capabilities within practice management disciplines.
- Ability to travel extensively (approximately 400 engagements annually, one-third in person, including roughly 150 overnight stays).
- FINRA Series 7 and 66 licenses, or equivalent, required.

“I can apply in less than 4 minutes.”

At Capital Group, the success of the people who invest with us depends on the people in whom we invest. That’s why we offer a culture, compensation and opportunities that empower our associates to build successful and prosperous careers. Through nine decades, our goal has been to improve people’s lives through successful investing. We know that our history is a testament to the strength of the people we hire. More than 9,000 associates in 30+ offices around the world help our clients and each other grow and thrive every day. Find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and Glassdoor. ‎

“I can succeed as the Global Finance Senior Manager at Capital Group.”

At Capital Group, we believe in the power of insight to drive enterprise value. Our Strategic Analysis (SA) team is a high-impact capability center within Global Finance, designed to elevate decision-making, accelerate transformation, and enable scalable growth across the firm.

As the Global Finance Senior Manager – Strategic Analysis (London), you will play a critical role as a thought partner to senior leaders across Capital Group to drive clarify, influence our global strategic direction, and deliver insights that shape Capital Group’s long-term global trajectory.

To thrive in this role, you will collaborate closely with high performing teams and leverage your strategy and analytical skills to navigate through ambiguity, bring structure to complexity and solve global enterprise-level challenges.

Responsibilities:

- Partner with cross-functional leaders to help answer key strategic questions through thoughtful framing and rigorous analysis

- Translate complex data into insights and compelling narratives that inform strategy, investment prioritization, and resource allocation.

- Drive initiatives aligned with Capital Group’s Long-Term Strategic Plan (LTSP), including strategic evaluation of new business initiatives, product economics, cost optimization, compensation analytics, operating model evolution, and enterprise transformation.

- Add to our culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

- Serve as a connector across the enterprise, helping to align business priorities with financial and operational insights.

- Be a role model for Capital Group’s core values.

- Coach and inspire associates across Global Finance and our partner teams, help develop future leaders, and operate with high quality and efficiency.

“I am the right person Capital Group is looking for.”

- You have 5+ years of experience in management consulting, or 10+ years in corporate strategy or relevant strategic finance roles preferably in asset management or financial services.

- You are a proven strategic leader with demonstrated success in driving change and delivering measurable impact through hypothesis-driven problem solving.

- You are well versed in navigating high degrees of complexity and ambiguity with stakeholders at all levels and can steer through the cross-functional organizational maze to get things done for Capital.

- You are energized by ambiguity and excel at bringing clarity and direction to complex challenges.

- You see the big picture, set objectives to align to broader organizational goals and breakdown objectives into appropriate initiatives and actions.

- You collaborate and develop/maintain working relationships to enable effective completion of business objectives and influence decision-making.

- You embody our core values and can motivate and develop a high performing team.

You will define procurement strategy execution frameworks, design and embed scalable processes and systems that enable visibility, efficiency, and control across external spend.  This includes leadership of intake and orchestration, procure-to-pay, contract management, 3rd party data & analytics, practice and capability enablement, and governance practices across ESO.  You will own and drive the operational Enterprise Source-to-Pay transformation, defining the roadmap, priorities, and sequencing to build scalable, best-in-class procurement capabilities and position ESO for continued evolution and growth, in partnership with Finance, Legal, InfoSec, Risk Management, and Global Technology teams.

“I can succeed as a Quantitative Research Associate at Capital Group”
As a member of the Quantitative Research and Analytics group (QRA) at Capital Group (CG), you conduct rigorous peer-reviewed quantitative research and analysis.  You leverage your knowledge of portfolio optimization, trading strategies and portfolio analysis to develop effective systematic strategies for portfolio construction and replication.  You enjoy a balance of collaborative problem-solving, individual exploration, and continuous learning.

You effectively communicate concepts and conclusions from quantitative analysis to investors, partner groups, and internal governance bodies.  You identify and communicate the factors driving returns in systematic portfolios.

In this role you will:
- Deliver high-impact research on portfolio construction and optimization.
- Develop and maintain relevant quantitative models and frameworks.
- Partner with QRA leadership, Portfolio Strategy Management leadership, and Investment Group associates to understand and execute on quantitative research and analytical priorities.
- Work collaboratively with members of the QRA team in a rigorous peer-reviewed approach to quantitative research and support the team with portfolio optimization expertise.
- Respond to deadline-driven requests requiring quantitative analysis.
- Participate in the ongoing development of quantitative research processes at CG.
- Communicate results and recommendations in a form that meets the needs of the listener.
- Help develop computing environments to support research and research-driven processes in a collaborative research environment.

”I am the person Capital Group is looking for”
- You have advanced knowledge of optimization methods (including convex, non-linear, and integer programming) and systematic portfolio construction methods, with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
- You have excellent systems and computer skills, including demonstrable expertise with quantitative programming languages (e.g., Python, Julia, or R) and with optimization software (e.g. Gurobi or Mosek)
- You have at a minimum a basic knowledge of fundamental research, econometrics and modern financial economic theory: e.g. asset pricing, portfolio theory, factor risk models, and machine learning.
- You have excellent quantitative research skills, as evidenced by an advanced degree (MFE, MSc, PhD) in a mathematically robust discipline (e.g., mathematics, economics, operations research) or equivalent experience.
- You exhibit advanced communication skills – the ability to synthesize issues into solutions, translate complex concepts into simple language, and engage across different audiences.

- You are self-motivated, take initiative, and demonstrate commitment to continuously improve skills and self.
- You are curious about financial markets, optimization and portfolio construction, and are always learning something new.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Associate
jobs.description:
Capital Group is a privately owned, independent investment manager that is one of the world’s largest active managers with $2.7tn in AUM (at end Dec 2021). Our company’s mission is to improve people's lives through successful investing and our business is set up to deliver on this consistently and over the long-term. The four core beliefs that are central to our investing success are our distinctive way of managing money, deep fundamental research, taking a true long-term view, and the power of partnerships.

We are looking a highly motivated and dynamic salesperson to join our Hong Kong-based financial intermediaries (FIT) sales team. The FIT client segment and the Hong Kong & Greater China region both play a significant role in Capital Group’s plan to grow our business. This role will report into the FIT team head responsible for leading and developing Capital’s intermediary business in the region. The head of the Hong Kong & Greater China Client Group will also play an important role in ensuring that the organization provides what you need to be successful at Capital Group and have a fulfilling, rewarding career over the long-term.

This role will support the FIT business with a focus on maximizing sales opportunities with clients and prospects especially in building client relationships with investment consultants and relationship managers particularly in the retail segment (e.g. banks, insurers, etc.). We will work with you to set your dedicated coverage across retail, private banks and insurance channels. This role provides the opportunity to engage clients at different stages of their client journey, from prospecting to acquiring and retaining assets. Activities include branch visits, client trainings, engaging clients in positioning products, networking and building contacts and support the FIT team head and BDM in managing accounts over time.

Collaboration is a key part of Capital Group’s success and its culture. There is a strong element of partnering with our internal support teams, e.g. investment specialists, investment products & services, marketing, and Legal & Compliance in order to respond to queries and service clients and prospects. There will be close working relationships with the HK-based and key European FIT sales teams. Highly collaborative and non-territorial sales teams across the US, Europe, and Asia work together to support global FIT clients.

The role is based in our Hong Kong office, which was established in 1983, with over 100 staff members including Sales, Marketing, Investment Professionals and many supporting functions.

Primary responsibilities:

Client-centric and consultative sales skills
- Build and maintain high quality business relationships with investment consultants, relationship managers, insurance agents, take an interest in your clients
- Support the FIT team head and BDM in managing accounts to achieve business growth and brand awareness - Provide end-to-end sales supports including preparation for meetings and coordinating post-meeting follow ups
- Preparing regular investment markets and product updates for clients and engage clients via relevant and effective channels, conduct cold-calling, events/webinars, client education, etc.
- Handling inbound requests and questions from clients
- Drive sales by planning and conducting branch visits, trainings, keeping RMs/ICs/Agents updated as markets evolve and differentiating against competing funds

- Maintain a high level of activity in engaging with clients to drive bottom-up demand and through the network, keep abreast to industry and organisation news.
- Working on ad hoc projects to deepen understanding of clients and sales opportunities

Identifying opportunities
- Stay on top of product and client trends and keep your ear close to the ground
- Support knowledge transfer of market intel to sales and product teams

Internal Capital Group navigation and collaboration
- Work collaboratively with colleagues to bring the scale of Capital Group to your clients, e.g. financial intermediaries and institutional Sales teams in HK and other markets, Investment Directors, Investment Products & Services, Investment Professionals, Marketing, Client Servicing, RFP, Business Data & Analytics; to support your client efforts, share ideas and best practices.

Sales collaboration
- Liaison with other teams at Capital Group to create high quality deliverables to clients (Sales teams in other markets, Investment Directors, Investment Professionals, Marketing, Client Service, (investment) Results team, RFP team, Legal & Compliance, etc.)

- Work as part of a collegial team of sales associates that shares ideas and best practices; alignment with Singapore sales team is particularly important
- Collaborate with key European/US sales teams and Enterprise Relationship Management team to ensure global distributor relationships are coordinated and seamless

Core competencies:
- Action oriented : Readily takes action on challenges, without unnecessary planning. Identifies and seizes new opportunities. Displays a can-do attitude in good and bad times. Steps up to handle tough issues
- Drives results : Has a strong bottom-line orientation. Persists in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks. Has a track record of exceeding goals successfully. Pushes self and helps others achieve results
- Builds networks : Builds strong formal and informal networks internally and externally. Maintains relationships across a variety of functions and locations. Maturity in leading and deepening partnerships. High EQ.
- Client focus (consultative approach) : Gains insight into customer needs. Identifies opportunities that benefit the customer. Builds and delivers solutions that meet customer expectations. Establishes and maintains effective customer relationships
- Communicates effectively : Is effective in a variety of communication settings: one-on-one, small and large groups, or among diverse styles and position levels. Attentively listens to others. Adjusts to fit the audience and the message. Provides timely and helpful information to others across the organization. Encourages the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
- Resourcefulness : Marshals resources to get things done. Orchestrates multiple activities simultaneously to accomplish a goal. Gets the most out of limited resources. Applies knowledge of internal structures, processes, policies, and culture to resourcing efforts.
- Collaborates : Works cooperatively with others across the organization to achieve shared objectives. Represents own interests while being fair to others and their areas. Partners with others to get work done. Credits others for their contributions and accomplishments. Gains trust and support of others
- Nimble learning : Learns quickly when facing new situations. Experiments to find new solutions. Takes on the challenge of unfamiliar tasks; intellectually curiosity. Extracts lessons learned from failures.
- Business insight : Demonstrates an in-depth knowledge of the investment and financial services industry in Hong Kong in terms of products, competitors, market practices, and trends
- Investment knowledge : Good level of investment knowledge of markets, macroeconomics and asset classes. Will be supported by a team of seven APAC Investment Specialists (many more global colleagues) and APAC investment products and services associates (many more European colleagues)

- 5-8 years of sales/sales support experience with established relationships with financial intermediaries
- Strong interpersonal and presentation skills, client facing experience preferred

- Fluent in English and Cantonese, proficiency in Mandarin

As a Senior Manager, Category Management, you will lead the Enterprise Aligned Technology Category Management team within the Enterprise Sourcing Office (ESO), overseeing global enterprise sourcing strategies across a broad portfolio that includes Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Services, Enterprise Software, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Networking, Hardware, and Technology Services.

You will partner with senior Technology, Data, Finance, Risk, and business leaders to develop category strategies that optimize technology investments, manage risk, accelerate innovation, and deliver long-term business value. Leveraging your expertise in technology markets, cloud services, software licensing, cybersecurity, and AI ecosystems, you will lead complex sourcing initiatives, supplier negotiations, and strategic supplier relationships across Capital Group's technology spend portfolio.

You will also lead and develop a growing team of category management professionals and managers, helping shape the future of the organization while driving sourcing excellence, supplier governance, and category management best practices. As a key leader within the Enterprise Sourcing Office transformation, you will influence executive stakeholders, build organizational capabilities, and help create a more strategic, business-focused sourcing function.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

- You have 10+ years of experience in technology sourcing, category management, procurement, supplier management, or a related commercial discipline, with 12+ years preferred.
- You have experience managing complex technology categories, including AI, cloud services, enterprise software, cybersecurity, infrastructure, networking, hardware, and technology services.
- You have successfully developed and executed sourcing and category strategies that align with business and technology priorities.
- You have deep knowledge of technology supplier markets, cloud economics, software licensing models, cybersecurity solutions, and emerging AI technologies.
- You have led complex negotiations and supplier relationships with significant business and financial impact.
- You have a minimum of 3-5 years of people leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and leading high-performing teams.
- You have experience leading managers and supporting organizations through periods of growth, change, and transformation.
- You are highly skilled at influencing senior leaders and building trusted relationships across Technology, Finance, Risk, Legal, and business teams.
- You are comfortable navigating competing priorities, delivering difficult recommendations, and driving alignment without formal authority.
- You have strong commercial, analytical, and problem-solving skills and can translate market insights into strategic business decisions.
- You are an effective communicator who can present complex technology and sourcing concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- You are a strategic thinker who combines business partnership, category expertise, and people leadership to create lasting enterprise value.
- You have a bachelor's degree; an advanced degree or relevant sourcing certifications are a plus.

"I can suceed as a Compliance Manager"

As a key member of the Europe-APAC exJapan (EA) Compliance Distribution, Sales and Marketing (DSM) Compliance team, this role supports the EA DSM Compliance Senior Manager in leading the Asia Pacific exJapan DSM Compliance function. This manager position provides leadership, strategic direction, and technical expertise to the Asia Pacific DSM Compliance team and works closely with its European counterpart to ensure a coordinated and effective compliance framework across the regions and globally.

The role is responsible for providing advice and overseeing compliance on Distribution, Sales and Marketing activities across Asia Pacific exJapan, including marketing communications, RFPs, regulatory guidance on cross-border prospecting activities, and the corresponding sales and marketing oversight. The role also leads the development and implementation of compliance policies, guidance, and training, while partnering closely with Legal, Risk, and Compliance colleagues globally.

In addition, this person will support the Asia Pacific MLRO in overseeing and approving clients in the region from a financial crime compliance perspective.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain trusted relationships with business leadership and associates across the Distribution, Sales and Marketing functions, providing practical, risk-based compliance advice and fostering a strong culture of compliance. The role is expected to drive continuous improvement, foster collaboration across jurisdictions, and adapt effectively to evolving business and regulatory needs.

Role & Responsibilities:
Distribution, Sales and Marketing Advisory & Compliance
- Lead and manage the Asia Pacific DSM Compliance team under the direction of the EA DSM Compliance Manager, providing strategic leadership, oversight, coaching, and development.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to EA Marketing, Sales, and Sales Leadership, providing risk-based compliance guidance on distribution, sales, marketing, and cross-border activities.

- Oversee the review and approval of marketing and client-facing materials, including marketing communications, DDQs, RFIs, RFPs, websites, social media, and other promotional content, ensuring compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, and internal requirements.

- Lead the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of compliance policies, guidance, processes, and controls supporting EA sales and marketing activities across Asia Pacific.

- Monitor regulatory developments and emerging risks, assessing business impacts, providing training and guidance, and driving appropriate responses across the region.

- Lead and contribute to regional and global strategic initiatives, identifying and resolving complex compliance issues while promoting operational efficiency and consistent practices across jurisdictions.

- Build and maintain effective relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including Distribution, Sales and Marketing leadership and associates, Legal, Risk & Compliance colleagues globally, external counsel, auditors, regulators, and industry associations, fostering collaboration and a strong culture of compliance across the organization.

AML Compliance Officer
- Support the Asia Pacific MLRO in the oversight and approval of clients in the region from an AML and financial crime compliance perspective, in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal policies.

- Provide advice and challenge on AML, sanctions, anti-bribery and corruption, and other financial crime matters relating to client onboarding, ongoing due diligence, escalations, and periodic reviews.

- Work with operations, and business teams to ensure AML-related policies, procedures, controls, training, and monitoring remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations and global standards.

"I am the person Capital Group is looking for."
- Proven leadership and people management experience, with the ability to lead, develop, and motivate a team across multiple jurisdictions.

- Extensive knowledge of the financial services industry and the Asia Pacific and global investment management regulatory environment.

- Understanding of AML and financial crime compliance requirements, including client due diligence, sanctions screening, suspicious activity escalation, and financial crime risk management.

- Strong analytical and judgment skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulations and provide practical, risk-based advice.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across Sales, Marketing, and Legal, Risk & Compliance.

- Strategic mindset with a focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

- Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.

- High levels of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail, with the ability to leverage technology and automation to enhance compliance processes and efficiency.

Core Requirements
- University degree required; legal, compliance, regulatory, or other relevant professional qualifications/certifications are an advantage.

- 10+ years of relevant compliance experience within the financial services industry (asset management, investment funds, banking, or financial advisory services), or with a leading consulting or audit firm supporting such institutions.

- Demonstrated leadership and people management experience, including leading, developing, and coaching compliance professionals and managing teams across multiple jurisdictions.

- Demonstrated experience providing compliance oversight and advisory support for distribution, sales, marketing, financial promotions, and cross-border activities across Asia Pacific.

- Demonstrated experience with AML and financial crime compliance oversight, including client due diligence, sanctions screening, escalations, monitoring, and coordination with an MLRO or equivalent financial crime leadership.

- Strong understanding of the Asia Pacific investment management regulatory landscape and relevant global regulatory frameworks.

- Experience partnering with senior business stakeholders, including Sales, Marketing, and executive leadership, and influencing outcomes in a complex regulatory environment.

- Fluent in spoken and written English; proficiency in an additional Asia Pacific language (e.g., Mandarin) would be an advantage.

" I can succeed as the Enterprise AI Strategy Principal at Capital Group."
As the Enterprise AI Strategy Principal, you will help shape how Capital Group applies AI to create enduring business value. Working directly with enterprise and line-of-business leaders, you will develop AI strategies, identify transformational opportunities, and translate them into clear strategic choices and compelling business cases.

This is a high-visibility strategy role for someone who wants to work at the intersection of AI, investment management, and enterprise transformation. You will join an established AI organization with strong momentum and help business leaders move from experimentation to measurable results.

The role offers broad exposure across Capital Group and the opportunity to build relationships with leaders across our businesses. It is well suited to a strategist who wants to develop deep expertise in enterprise AI while building the context and credibility to pursue broader leadership opportunities over time.

Key responsibilities
- Serve as a forward-deployed AI strategist. Partner deeply with individual lines of business to assess their AI maturity, clarify their highest-value opportunities, and develop strategies tailored to their business priorities.

- Partner with line of business leaders to build AI strategies and prioritize opportunities. Assess where AI can create enduring value across investing, distribution and operations. Size the upside, both revenue and opportunity to create capacity, and build business cases and roadmaps that leaders can approve and fund.
- Track the market and competitors. Engage with industry leaders to keep a pulse on how asset managers, wealth managers, technology platform providers and frontier model providers are moving. Partner with leadership to surface early signals and implications for competitive strategy. Bring outside ideas into the firm's strategic discussions and decision-making on the application of AI.
- Shape the firm's point of view on the strategic implications of AI. Run scenario work on how AI may change the business over the next 3-5 years (e.g., how investors get advice, who influences investment decisions, implications for our sales and go-to-market strategy, product design, investment processes).

- Connect strategy to execution. Partner closely with product, engineering, data, business and enterprise AI team to translate strategic priorities into actionable priorities and establish measures of success. Product and business teams will own implementation, while you help preserve strategic intent across our portfolio and partner with Finance to ensure we realize business value.

- Build responsible AI into the strategy. Work with our AI Accelerator Platform Leadership Team including Line of Business Leaders, Risk, Information Security, Legal, Data and Technology so the recommendations reflect governance, regulation, data readiness and client trust from the start.
- Communicate clearly for leaders. Produce short, insightful communications for key leadership groups and forums to inform robust strategic decision-making.  Explain complex AI topics in plain business terms.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”
- Experience: Significant experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or internal strategy, with demonstrated progression and experience advising senior leaders. Experience framing complex strategic questions, developing business cases, and advising senior leaders is essential. Experience in financial services is strongly preferred.
- AI knowledge: You understand the business implications of generative and agentic AI and can engage credibly with product, data, and technology partners. Deep technical expertise is not required, but intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated commitment to building AI fluency are essential.
- Skills: comfortable working through ambiguity, building scenarios and financial models, and influencing senior leaders without direct authority through clear, concise executive communication.
- Mindset: curious, open-minded and collaborative, and willing to follow ideas that challenge current plans.

Working closely with the Country Marketing Managers (CMMs) and the wider Asia marketing team, the CMA is execution-focused and will help deliver product and brand campaigns, client events, bilingual marketing materials and day-to-day marketing operations. Activities may be carried out independently or jointly with agencies, vendors and internal teams, depending on their size and complexity.

1. Product and brand campaign execution
- Support the execution and coordination of product and brand campaigns across the FIT HK marketing calendar, including asset trafficking, version control and deployment tracking.

- Coordinate with agencies, vendors and internal teams (e.g. design, digital, publishing, Legal & Compliance) to deliver campaign assets on time and on budget.

- Help ensure localized campaign assets (English and Traditional Chinese) follow Capital Group brand guidelines and local regulatory requirements, under the guidance of the CMMs.

- Support campaign tracking and compile post-campaign reports to help measure results.

2. Events and on-site support
- Provide logistical support for CG-hosted, distributor-led and industry sponsored events, from planning through to on-site execution.

- Support the event communication pipeline for all touchpoints: save the date, invitations, reminders, registration and post-event follow-up.

- Coordinate with venues, event agencies, caterers and vendors, and prepare event materials, branding and premiums to meet CG standards.

- Handle attendee management and maintain event records in internal systems.

3. Marketing materials review and coordination (English / Traditional Chinese)
- Proofread English and Traditional Chinese marketing materials, online and offline, and coordinate printing and production.

- Coordinate translation requests with vendors and internal publishing teams, tracking turnaround against agreed timelines and SLAs.

- Support Traditional Chinese review and user acceptance testing (UAT) for website updates and new digital capabilities.

4. Digital
- Support the build and review of campaign webpages, eDMs and social media posts with internal digital teams.

- Help maintain the campaign/product and BAU webpages, making sure content is accurate, aligned and up to date in both languages.

5. Marketing operations
- Source and coordinate the production of CG-branded premiums, and manage the inventory overview to inform replenishment where needed.

- Submit invoices, follow up with vendors where needed and support marketing budget tracking.

- Raise Workfront tickets and resource requests, and help keep the marketing calendar up to date.

- Contribute to ad hoc marketing initiatives, including strategic and transformation projects such as GenAI-enabled translation and workflow improvements.

- Take part in regional and global marketing project teams, and suggest process improvements where possible.

- 2–5 years’ marketing experience, ideally in asset management, wealth management or financial services; experience with events, campaigns or agencies is an advantage.

- High proficiency in written and spoken English and Traditional Chinese, with strong proofreading skills; Mandarin is a plus.

- Strong attention to detail, with the discipline to work within fixed SLAs and tight deadlines.

- Highly organised and reliable, with good coordination skills and the ability to handle multiple workstreams.

“I can succeed as a Trade Operations Analyst Senior at Capital Group.”

You have a genuine interest in collateral management, derivatives, and fixed income securities, along with a strong focus on client centricity. You’ll play a critical role in the post-trade process, supporting margin management, collateral obligations, product lifecycle activities, and settlement functions. Role Summary

Global Financial Intermediaries (GFIs) are among Capital Group's most important strategic relationships and represent a significant long-term growth opportunity across wealth, discretionary, insurance, sub-advisory and digital distribution channels. These firms operate across multiple geographies, business lines and client segments and increasingly require coordinated engagement across markets.

We are seeking a high-performing Business Development Associate to join the GFI team in London. The individual will partner closely with Business Development Managers responsible for Capital Group's largest strategic accounts while supporting broader fund selector, discretionary and strategic account initiatives across the GFI team.

This is a commercially focused business development role combining strategic account planning, client engagement, market intelligence, relationship development and cross-functional mobilisation. The successful candidate will play a meaningful role in helping Capital Group deepen partnerships with some of the world's largest financial institutions while contributing directly to business growth, strategic initiatives and client outcomes.
Over time, the individual will be expected to assume increasing ownership of strategic projects, client relationships and commercial activity across assigned accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Development
- Partner with Business Development Managers to support Capital Group's most significant global financial intermediary relationships.

- Contribute to the development, execution and ongoing management of account plans across priority strategic accounts.

- Identify opportunities to deepen relationships across advisory, discretionary, retail, insurance, sub-advisory and digital distribution channels.

- Develop a strong understanding of client organisations, key decision-makers, strategic priorities and competitive positioning.

- Coordinate activity across markets, functions and client segments to support delivery of account objectives.

- Support mobilisation around strategic initiatives, product launches and partnership opportunities across assigned firms.

- Maintain visibility of pipeline activity, relationship developments and commercial opportunities within Salesforce.

Client Engagement & Relationship Management
- Support the preparation, execution and follow-up of client meetings, due diligence sessions, conferences and industry events.

- Participate actively in client meetings, developing relationships with fund selectors, research analysts, discretionary portfolio managers and senior stakeholders.

- Build knowledge of client investment processes, business priorities and decision-making frameworks.

- Over time, assume ownership of selected client relationships, projects and engagement initiatives.

- Represent Capital Group professionally in client-facing situations and contribute to strengthening long-term partnerships.

Manager Selection & Investment Due Diligence
- Support and progressively lead engagement with fund selectors, research teams and investment committees across priority GFI relationships.

- Develop a detailed understanding of client manager selection frameworks, research priorities, due diligence requirements and approval processes.

- Coordinate responses to requests for information, due diligence reviews, investment research meetings and ongoing monitoring requirements.

- Partner with investment specialists, product teams and portfolio managers to position Capital Group strategies clearly and accurately within client selection processes.

- Track manager selection activity, ratings, approved-list status, review cycles and related commercial opportunities across assigned accounts.

Strategic Initiatives & Market Intelligence
- Support development of strategic themes and value propositions used in client engagement.

- Conduct market, competitor and industry research to identify emerging opportunities and risks.

- Contribute to the articulation and deployment of Capital Group's strategic partnership offering across GFI firms.

- Keep abreast of industry trends affecting wealth management, fund distribution and financial intermediaries.

- Support targeted marketing campaigns and coordinated engagement initiatives across strategic accounts.

Business Analytics & Commercial Insights
- Coordinate the production and analysis of account reporting, including assets, flows, market share, share of wallet, pipeline activity and relationship metrics.

- Gather and synthesise client intelligence to support strategic planning and business development activity.

- Partner with reporting, analytics and marketing teams to create actionable insights that help grow Capital Group's business with key intermediary partners.

- Monitor progress against account objectives and identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes.

Success Measures
- Meaningful contribution to growth across assigned strategic accounts.

- Development of trusted relationships with key client stakeholders.

- Effective execution of account plans and strategic initiatives.

- Successful coordination and mobilisation across internal stakeholders.

- Delivery of actionable commercial insights and market intelligence.

- Effective support and progression of manager selection, due diligence and approved-list opportunities.

- Growing ownership of client relationships and business development opportunities.

Skills & Experience
- Relevant client-facing experience in asset management, wealth management or financial services, ideally working directly with fund selectors, research teams or investment committees.

- Strong commercial instinct and interest in business development.

- Good understanding of investment markets, fund distribution and intermediary channels.

- Ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders both internally and externally.

- Strong analytical, organisational and project management skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Comfortable engaging with sophisticated clients and senior stakeholders.

- High energy, curiosity, accountability and attention to detail.

- Practical understanding of manager selection, investment due diligence and fund approval processes.

- IMC qualification or progression towards CFA designation preferred.

- Experience with Salesforce or another CRM platform preferred.
